usage.callShape: GET https://chainray.online/block-info (optional query params: chain=<evm-chain>, block=<number>)
usage.outputShape: body.number, body.hash, body.timestamp, body.timestampISO, body.gasUsed, body.gasLimit, body.transactionCount, body.miner, body.chain; cryptographic proof at body._proof
usage.guide: Plain x402-paid GET. Call GET https://chainray.online/block-info with no params to get the latest block on Base. Optionally add ?chain=<one of base|ethereum|arbitrum|optimism|polygon|bsc|avalanche|... (EVM chains only)> to switch chains, and ?block=<number> to fetch a specific block (omit for latest). The JSON body is the block metadata directly (number, hash, timestamp/timestampISO, gas fields, transactionCount, miner); read fields off the top-level body. body._proof carries a verifiable proof bundle if needed.
